text:
Priya Kapoor: Quick sync — need a final landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private by EOD tomorrow. Focus: launch posts, benchmark headline, webinar hero, and inbound lead routing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/example (edit). Can we prioritize?

Diego Morales: On it. I'll draft hero variants + 2 launch-post hooks. Any strict length constraints?

Ellie Chen: For hero we need H1 (<=10 words), H2 (one line), primary CTA, secondary CTA. I can mock visuals after copy.

Priya Kapoor: Yep — H1 ~6-8 words ideal. Make sure Dedicated mentions SLA/predictable throughput; Private mentions VPC/KMS. Hosted should be about fast time-to-value and transparent pricing. Also include a short benchmark line for the landing page and a one-liner for the webinar landing.

Samir Patel: Proposed AB test: Variant A (performance-first): "Low-latency inference, built for scale." Variant B (economics-first): "Reduce inference costs without sacrificing quality." We'll track engagement + signups.

Ava Martinez: I'll draft the social + launch posts. Want 3 hooks for Twitter, 2 for LinkedIn, and webinar blurb. Need final copy by 4pm to schedule posts.

LaunchBot: Reminder: copy-draft-deadline in 4h. :alarm_clock:

Diego Morales: Draft hero snippets below — please pick preferred ones and I'll iterate:
```
Hosted H1: "Instant LLM inference — start integrating in minutes"
Hosted H2: "Hosted API with predictable pricing, streaming responses, and dev-friendly SDKs."
Hosted CTAs: "Start free trial" / "View benchmarks"

Dedicated H1: "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput"
Dedicated H2: "Reserve capacity, SLA-backed latency, and enterprise isolation."
Dedicated CTAs: "Talk to sales" / "See capacity options"

Private H1: "Deploy inference inside your VPC or on-prem"
Private H2: "Full data controls, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logs."
Private CTAs: "Request private deployment" / "Schedule security review"
```

Ellie Chen: These read clean. Suggest tightening Hosted H2: "Fast onboarding, transparent pricing, streaming SDKs." Also I'll create two CTA button sizes.

Priya Kapoor: For inbound routing: Hosted -> Start free trial leads to signup flow. Dedicated -> 'Talk to sales' routes to AE queue with prefilled usage. Private -> 'Request private deployment' goes to solutions-engineering form. Ava, can you reflect that in posts?

Ava Martinez: Yep. For launch posts I'll pair Hosted hooks with demo GIF and a permalink to benchmarks, Dedicated/Private posts will link to webinar registration + contact form.

Samir Patel: Benchmark microcopy for landing page: "In our tests, Redwood served common completion workloads with p95 latency under 60ms on optimized configs — see full results." (link to benchmarks)

Priya Kapoor: Love it. Final asks: keep language approachable, avoid heavy ops jargon on Hosted page, but add clear infra cues on Dedicated/Private. Send final copy by 4pm and we'll freeze for creative handoff at 5pm. :thumbsup:

Diego Morales: Will push a v1 edit in the doc in 30m.

Ellie Chen: Will upload hero mockups by 3:30pm.

Ava Martinez: Scheduling checklist updated. :white_check_mark:

Priya Kapoor: Thanks team — let's ship this cleanly. :rocket:
